study type: Secondary analysis of a prospective cohort study
cohort: The study included 874 pregnant women, 177 of whom were diagnosed with gestational diabetes mellitus and received MedDiet-based medical nutrition therapy, and 697 women with normal glucose tolerance.
finding: Using MedDiet-based medical nutrition therapy in women with GDM is associated with achieving near-normoglycemia and making most pregnancy outcomes similar to those of women with normal glucose tolerance.
mod_finding: The rates of cesarean sections were comparable between women with gestational diabetes mellitus receiving MedDiet-based medical nutrition therapy and women with normal glucose tolerance.
gest_age: Participants were enrolled before 12 gestational weeks.
